contexts.text: Almost all believe that (marriage love) is innate...
The things which come forth from the interior memory appear as if they were innate. Example(s). AC 7935:2.
Innocence with innate forces. Signified, Explained.
Those of the Most Ancient Church... were born into the good of love... Hence the forces are called innate.
Falsification becomes total when falsity begins to reign; for then the man lives according to evil [both] innate and acquired...
(Scientifics then) almost vanish from the external memory, and appear as if they were innate, because they are implanted in the man's life.
Hence it is that to the (celestial) Angels Divine truths appear as if they were inscribed, or as if they were implanted and innate...
Therefore he was let into the life of evils which was innate to him.
Such a desire is innate with Spirits.
As this love is innate with both (sexes).
